Lemma
[Interpolation inequality for $L^p$-norms] ↗ lem:holders-inequality 1. appB:B.2-h\group Elementary Inequalities

Assume $1\leq s\leq r\leq t\leq \infty $ and \[ \frac1r=\frac\theta s+\frac{1-\theta }{t}. \] If $u\in L^s(U)\cap L^t(U)$, then $u\in L^r(U)$ and \[ (12)\qquad \| u\| _{L^r(U)} \leq \| u\| _{L^s(U)}^\theta \| u\| _{L^t(U)}^{1-\theta }. \]
Proof

\sketch In the nondegenerate case, factor

\[ |u|^r=|u|^{\theta r}|u|^{(1-\theta )r} \]

and apply Hölder with conjugate exponents $s/(\theta r)$ and $t/((1-\theta )r)$. Taking the $r$-th root gives (12). If $\theta \in \{ 0,1\} $ or an endpoint exponent is infinite, the same conclusion follows by omitting the corresponding factor and using its essential supremum.

□
